welcome.title: Welcome to Shopping Lists!
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour to help you get started with collaborative shopping lists. You can skip this anytime.

createList.title: Create Your First List
createList.description: Click here to create a new shopping list. You can have multiple lists for different purposes (weekly shopping, party planning, etc.)

aiAdd.title: AI-Powered Shopping
aiAdd.description: Just type what you need in natural language! For example: 'ingredients for pasta carbonara' or 'greek salad'. AI will add all items automatically.

manualAdd.title: Quick Manual Entry
manualAdd.description: Prefer typing items yourself? Just enter item names here and press Enter. You can adjust quantities later.

collaborators.title: Invite Friends & Family
collaborators.description: Share your list with others! They can add items, check things off, and shop together in real-time.

sendInventory.title: Send to Inventory
sendInventory.description: Completed shopping? Send checked items to your inventory to track what you have at home and get recipe suggestions!

complete.title: You're All Set! 🎉
complete.description: You now know the basics! Explore more features or restart this guide anytime from Settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to Inventory!
welcome.description: Track what you have at home and get smart recipe suggestions. Let's explore the key features together!

addItem.title: Add Items to Inventory
addItem.description: Click here to manually add items or send completed shopping items to inventory. Track quantities, expiration dates, and locations.

locations.title: Organize by Location
locations.description: Sort your items by storage location: Pantry, Fridge, Freezer, or Counter. This helps you find what you need quickly!

expiring.title: Track Expiring Items
expiring.description: Items close to expiration are highlighted here. Use them first to reduce food waste and save money!

recipes.title: Get Recipe Suggestions
recipes.description: Click here to get AI-powered recipe ideas using ingredients from your inventory. Smart cooking made easy!

complete.title: Inventory Mastered! 🎉
complete.description: You're ready to track your food inventory like a pro. Happy cooking!

welcome.title: Welcome to Recipe Discovery!
welcome.description: Explore thousands of community recipes from around the world. Let's see what you can do here!

aiSearch.title: AI Recipe Search
aiSearch.description: Just type what you want to cook! AI will search the web, find the recipe, and add it here automatically. Try 'chocolate cake' or 'pad thai'!

filters.title: Filter & Sort Recipes
filters.description: Use filters to find exactly what you need: cuisine type, difficulty level, dietary restrictions, and more. Sort by popularity or rating!

likeRate.title: Like & Rate Recipes
likeRate.description: Found something you love? Click the heart to save to favorites and rate recipes to help others discover great dishes!

create.title: Create Your Own Recipe
create.description: Have a unique recipe? Share it with the community! Our AI wizard helps you format it perfectly in just a few steps.

complete.title: Happy Cooking! 🎉
complete.description: You're ready to discover amazing recipes! Save your favorites and try something new today.

welcome.title: Welcome to My Recipes!
welcome.description: Your personal recipe collection in RCIP format. Save, organize, and cook your favorite dishes!

upload.title: Upload RCIP Files
upload.description: Have recipes in RCIP format? Upload them here to add to your collection. You can also import from other apps!

filters.title: Filter Your Collection
filters.description: Search and filter your recipes by difficulty, cuisine, or ingredients. Find the perfect dish for any occasion!

viewDetail.title: View Recipe Details
viewDetail.description: Click any recipe to see full instructions, ingredients, nutrition info, and cooking tips. Mark as cooked when you're done!

archive.title: Archive Recipes
archive.description: Not cooking something anymore? Archive it to keep your collection organized. You can always restore it from the Archive page later!

complete.title: Recipe Master! 🎉
complete.description: Your recipe collection is ready to use. Start cooking and enjoy delicious meals!

welcome.title: Welcome to Nutrition Tracker!
welcome.description: Track your daily nutrition, set goals, and get AI-powered coaching. Let's start your health journey!

goals.title: Your Nutrition Goals
goals.description: See your daily progress for calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Goals can be set manually or calculated by AI based on your profile!

addEntry.title: Log Your Meals
addEntry.description: Click here to add meals and track what you eat. You can log from recipes, inventory items, or manually enter nutrition info.

aiCoach.title: AI Nutrition Coach
aiCoach.description: Get personalized meal suggestions and coaching tips! Enable AI Coach in settings to unlock smart recommendations based on your goals.

settings.title: Nutrition Settings
settings.description: Customize your goals, enable AI coaching, and manage what data the AI can access to provide personalized suggestions.

complete.title: Healthy Eating! 🎉
complete.description: You're ready to track your nutrition and reach your health goals. Keep logging and stay consistent!

welcome.title: Welcome to Your Dashboard!
welcome.description: Your personal overview of everything - shopping, recipes, nutrition, and inventory. Let's explore what you can see here!

overview.title: Quick Stats Overview
overview.description: See your key metrics at a glance: spending, recipes cooked, inventory items, and nutrition tracking days. Everything important in one place!

insights.title: AI-Powered Insights
insights.description: Get daily personalized insights and recommendations from our AI. Tips about your spending, cooking habits, and nutrition all in one smart summary!

shopping.title: Shopping Insights
shopping.description: Track your grocery spending, see category breakdowns, and discover your most purchased items. Smart budgeting made easy!

inventory.title: Inventory Alerts
inventory.description: Get notified about expiring items and low stock. Never waste food again! Items that need attention are highlighted here.

complete.title: Dashboard Master! 🎉
complete.description: You now know how to use your dashboard to monitor everything. Check back regularly for insights and updates!

goal.nutrition_streak_description: Keep logging your meals to reach {{target}} days
